comment: Castrum Meridianum's BNpcBase 14572: what it did in three retail runs (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.8) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (visit 0.12) and 50e72631 (visit 0.3) of 2026-11-17, all with Duty Support; `questkit sources --duty 15`: its rotation's pace and each action's median amounts). A draft from Bob's Chronofoil captures (50e72631, 9ba7d981, af05916c), not yet checked in game: ContentFinderCondition 15, BNpcBase 14572, BNpcName 2109, level 50, 7663 HP, 9 seen in 3 runs. `players` and `npcs` are the median damage to each, `every` the median time between uses.

actions.comment: a 2.7 s cast on a spot: the spot one of the party stood on as it began (0.0 to 0.1 yalms off: the tank's, the player's or another member's), 0.8 to 8.9 yalms from it. Nine uses in five retail runs, once by each that cast it, 43.3 to 46.4 s into its fight (its first action or the first on it), so the three of a group cast it within half a second of each other (Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c and Bob's 9ba7d981, 50e72631, 6320ae56 and deea324c). Not used twice by one: `every` 600 keeps it to once a fight. Until 2026-11-20 it had no `every` and went on its target each turn it was free, at a set place (Bob's mark: "the random AOEs … have a set placement, and do not directly target players, they're supposed to resemble cannon bombardment")
